deploybot: Deploy Bot: FYI — planned soft-unpin of runtime v3.2 on canary tomorrow 23:00 UTC. Rollout window 2h. Default staged split 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Reply here to request hold or extended pin. Auto-rollback rules posted below.

sophia-eng: heads-up — we saw KVCACHE perf drift on longseq tests in yesterday's canary, 11% p95 up. prefer 10% hold and extra verification. :eyes:

amira-ml: +1 to the cautious path. our quant backend shows a latency bump on >8k tokens. suggest 10% for 1h, run longseq-regression evals, then continue if green.

raj: ops note — if we need fallback to runtime-3.1 nodes we'll need ~6h to warm capacity in eu-west. please flag early.

sophia-eng: proposed plan: 23:00 canary 10% for 60m monitoring p95/p99 + error rate. if within thresholds -> 23:40 bump to 50% for 30m -> final 100% at 00:10. rollback on triggers.

deploybot: Achieved — staged rollout configured. Posting rollback triggers for visibility:
```
- p95_latency > 1.5x baseline for 10m
- error_rate > 0.5% for 10m
- throughput drop > 25% for 15m
```

amira-ml: i'll add the "longseq-regression" eval set to the quality dashboard and wire alerts to #eng-oncall. will push thresholds by EOD.

ops-kate: noted. i've reserved the fallback capacity window and added maintenance tag. ops will be oncall during the rollout.

ci-bot: preflight: SDK compatibility tests ✅; model-variant conversion ✅; infra smoke ✅. small lint warning in the deployment manifest (non-blocking).

sophia-eng: ack — i'll be on-call 23:00-02:00 UTC and watching traces/kvcache metrics. ping me with any anomalies. :thumbsup:

raj: reserving fallback nodes & routing hold ready. will confirm when warm.

opsbot: reminder scheduled: runtime v3.2 soft-unpin canary @ 2026-03-29 23:00 UTC (thread 2923456789). Automatic rollback hooks enabled.

deploybot: final note — please add any last-minute objections within the next 3 hours or we'll proceed with the staged plan. :shipit:
